title: City life
subtitle: rush hour, traffic jam, nightlife, crime rate
summary: Talk about the good and bad sides of living in a big city, from the rush hour to the nightlife.

lesson.heading: The rush hour
lesson.text: The **rush hour** is the time when people travel to and from work. Everywhere is busy and everyone seems to be **in a hurry** - they want to do things quickly.

examples.text: For me, the **rush hour** is the worst time of day.

examples.note: a traffic jam is a long line of cars that are not moving; get stuck = become unable to move

examples.text: There's nowhere to **park** because the **car park** is already full.
The journey is very **stressful**, and I feel **exhausted** when I get home.
examples.note: stressful = causing a lot of worry; exhausted = very tired

lesson.text: The situation was **stressful** and I was **stressed** (not ~~I was stressing~~). And say *a car park* or *a parking space*, not ~~a parking~~.

lesson.heading: The nightlife
lesson.text: **Nightlife** means the places you visit in the evening for social reasons. One of the **advantages of** living in a city is that the town centre is **lively** - full of activity.

examples.text: There is a wide **variety of** bars, clubs and restaurants.
examples.note: a variety of = many different things

examples.text: If you are interested in **culture**, you can go to the cinema, the theatre, concerts or art galleries.
The town centre is always **lively** in the evening.
The **advantages** are the positive things; the opposite is **disadvantages**.

lesson.heading: The disadvantages of city life
lesson.text: Cities can be **crowded**, **dirty** and **dangerous**. **Pollution** - dirty air and water - is worse in big cities, and so is the **crime rate**, the number of crimes that happen.

examples.text: I only walk home **at night** if I'm with a friend.
When I'm on my own, I get a taxi.
Flats cost a lot, so you get better **value for money** in a smaller town.
examples.note: good value for money = you are happy with what you get for the money you pay

lesson.heading: The positive side
lesson.text: In a big city you **get** a real **mix** of people and nationalities - *get* here means *you find* or *there exists*. There is always something **going on**, so life is never **dull**.

examples.text: You **get** a real **mix** of people and nationalities in a big city.

lesson.heading: Compound words for city life
rows: a long line of cars that are not moving
places to go in the evening
what you get for the price you pay
the number of crimes that happen
the time when people travel to and from work
a place to leave a car

exercises.prompt: Match the words on the left with the words on the right to make compounds.
Match each word with its opposite.
*A:* Is there plenty to do in the evening? *B:* Yes, the ___ is great.
exercises.explanation: Nightlife = the places you visit in the evening for social reasons.

exercises.prompt: *A:* Are there lots of ___ activities in the town? *B:* Yes. There's a cinema, theatre and concerts.
exercises.explanation: Cinema, theatre and concerts are cultural activities.

exercises.prompt: *A:* Is it good for shopping? *B:* Yes, there's a ___ of shops.
exercises.explanation: A variety of = many different things of the same type.

exercises.prompt: *A:* Is the traffic bad? *B:* Yes, I often get ___ in traffic jams.
exercises.explanation: Get stuck = become unable to move or go anywhere.

exercises.prompt: *A:* Is your flat expensive? *B:* It's not cheap, but I think it's quite good ___ for money.
exercises.explanation: Good value for money = you are happy with what you get for the price.

exercises.prompt: Are you worried about walking home late in the evening? Yes, it can be dangerous ___ .
exercises.explanation: At night = in the period when it is dark.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite without the underlined words: 'I was very tired.' -> I was ___ .
Rewrite without the underlined words: 'I was very nervous and worried.' -> I was very ___ .
exercises.explanation: A stressful situation makes you stressed.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite without the underlined words: 'The place is always full of activity.' -> The place is always very ___ .
Rewrite without the underlined words: 'The air is dirty.' -> There's a lot of ___ .
Rewrite without the underlined words: 'They want to do everything very quickly.' -> They want to do everything in a ___ .
exercises.explanation: In a hurry = wanting to do something quickly.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite without the underlined words: 'There isn't much happening here.' -> There isn't much ___ here.

exercises.statement: 'There was nowhere to leave the car' means the same as 'There was nowhere to park'.
exercises.explanation: Correct. Park = leave your car somewhere.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in order to make a sentence about big cities.
exercises.answer: You get a real mix of people in a big city.
exercises.explanation: Here get means 'you find' or 'there exists'; a mix = different types.
